name: floating-input
title: Floating input
description: A text field whose label floats up on focus, with a hint and an error state. CSS only.

props.name: label
props.description: Text of the label that floats from inside the field up into its border.

props.name: hint
props.description: Quiet help text under the field; it is replaced by `error` while there is one.

props.name: error
props.description: Shown in red under the field, and marks the field invalid.

a11y.text: The label is a real label tied to the input by htmlFor, using id or a generated one. The hint is linked with aria-describedby while there is no error. The error lives in a persistent alert region, so one that appears while typing is announced, and aria-describedby then points to it and the input sets aria-invalid. The hint is not announced again. The label floats with CSS only, and all other input props pass through.
The label's float transition is off under reduced motion.
